services.name: Private lesson at home
services.story: The same $150 lesson, paid in full when booking, as some coaches ask. A $150 group class at a host's place is paid in full this way too.

services_shape: class: a seat in a set class time by coding, age group and level, with a set number of seats, a few trial seats and a waitlist; each learner booked is checked in on their own. Private lessons book one teacher, at the school, at a home, or by video. A class at a host's place (a school, a company office, a library) books a teacher's time for a group
questions_before_times: who is learning: the adult themselves, or the parent's child (the age sets the class)
which coding, and the level: never studied, some before, or a fluent speaker who wants a refresher
the goal: travel, school, work, or fun
at the school, by video, or at home
for a class at a host's place: how many learners, their ages, and the place
safety_stop: someone hurt right now: a hard fall, a head injury, a shock from a plug or battery, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing
first_steps: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
Placement for a learner who knows some of the code
license: none for a coding lab or a coach in most places; where the state's form names a license or registration, the owner adds it as an optional item. Rosie checks no license, certificate, insurance or background check
staff_skills: Python, Scratch, JavaScript and web basics; project review; children's classes only for coaches the owner OKs for children
messages_never: a child's last name, age, school, login or screen name, learning or health notes, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the class, and link to the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
